title: Security scans
intro: Check the servers you run for malware, unexpected file changes, weak host settings and vulnerable images.
noServers: No servers yet. Scans appear here once Polaris runs apps on a server.
loadFailed: Could not load this server. Try again in a moment.

malware.hint: Scans app data for known malware. Signatures are fetched the first time and refreshed on every scan.
malware.found: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing found} one {# file found} other {# files found}}
malware.stale: Signatures could not be refreshed; the scan used the last ones fetched.
malware.deleteConfirm: Delete this file for good? It cannot be restored afterwards.

files.hint: Record every file's fingerprint once, then check later what was added, removed or changed.

host.hint: Audits the server's own settings against hardening checks. The host is only read.
host.updatesHint: Lets the server install its distribution's security updates by itself.
host.updatesUnsupported: This server's distribution has no supported automatic updates mechanism.
host.scheduleHint: Runs every scan on this server on its own, one at a time.

images.hint: Checks each app's running image for known vulnerabilities and lists its software.

queued: Scan queued. It starts as soon as the server is free.

errors.invalid: Check the values and try again.
errors.noVolumes: That volume is no longer on this server.
errors.noBaseline: Record a baseline for this folder first.
errors.noApp: That app is no longer on this server.
errors.notRunning: This app has no running release to scan.
errors.noSignatures: Malware signatures could not be downloaded. Check that the server reaches the internet.
errors.scanError: The scan stopped with an error. Try again.
errors.tooManyFiles: Too many files to record here. Pick a smaller folder.
errors.noFolder: That folder does not exist in the volume.
errors.noTool: The audit tools could not be downloaded. Check that the server reaches the internet.
errors.daemonOutdated: This needs a newer Polaris. Update from Settings, then try again.
errors.busy: Another host check is running on this server. Try again when it ends.
errors.lost: The scan stopped before it finished. Try again.
errors.timeout: The scan took too long and was stopped.
errors.fileGone: The file is no longer there.
errors.pathTaken: A file already exists where this one would be restored.
errors.quarantineFailed: The file could not be moved. Try again.
errors.updatesFailed: Could not read or change automatic updates on this server.
errors.imageMissing: The image this app runs is no longer on the server. Redeploy the app, then scan again.
errors.noRoom: Not enough free disk on the server to check this image. Free some space, then try again.
